snippet.title: Thousand Hells: The Underworld Heists - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a trip straight into hell, again and again... Thousand Hells is coming September 8th, 2026. Learn more: https://bit.ly/44ZwWjY

A new systemic storybook experience from the designers of King of Dragon Pass and Six Ages.

Trailer Credits
Narrator: Dominick Rabrun
Music by Neha Patel: https://www.nehapatelaudio.com/
True Face (Drums) by NightWolfCFM -- https://freesound.org/s/608769/ -- License: Attribution 4.0

Sign up for the Thousand Hells newsletter:  https://bit.ly/43xLNQA   

Developed by A Sharp and published by Kitfox Games.
